headings.text: What makes a great AI code assistant

faq.q: Will AI code assistants replace programmers?
faq.a: No — they make good programmers 30-50% more productive. They can't yet design systems, make architectural decisions, or debug novel issues without guidance.

faq.q: Which is best for a team?
faq.a: GitHub Copilot for established teams (deep GitHub integration). Cursor for solo developers or startups who want a complete IDE experience.

faq.q: Are my code and prompts used for training?
faq.a: On free tiers: usually yes. On paid business tiers: typically no (opt-out is standard). Always check each tool's data policy before using proprietary code.
